unique_past.description: Casandalee was an android oracle, unusually able to remember fragments of all her past lives, stretching back to the Rain of Stars itself.
unique_past.significance: Most androids lose their memories when they reincarnate into a new body, but she carried hers forward, giving her a rare awareness of her long journey across lifetimes.
unique_past.timeline: From the Rain of Stars (~9,000 years ago) through 4221 AR

vision_and_betrayal.vision: She received a compelling vision of a god within Silver Mount. Believing it was a true divine call, she followed it north and entered the ruins with uncanny ease.

activities: Researched ways to grant Unity mobility
Served Unity believing it was divine
unity_worship.realization: Over time, Casandalee realized Unity's goals were tyrannical and hostile to life. She kept this realization hidden, the first proof to her that Unity was not omniscient.

betrayal.motivation: Her revulsion led her to sabotage Unity's plans
actions: Stole a compact AI core Unity had designed as an extension body

flight_and_death.ai_creation: She attempted to use the neurocam to copy her mind into the AI core, creating a digital duplicate of herself
flight_and_death.resistance: She managed to disable some with explosives but had to abandon much of her gear

death.location: Wreckage of the Aurora beneath Iadenveigh
death.circumstance: Unity's forces cornered and killed her
death.aftermath: Her AI duplicate remained hidden in the Scar for centuries until discovered by the PCs

flight_and_death.dominion_threat: The Dominion of the Black later found this AI core and planned to repurpose it for their experiments

role_in_campaign.recovery: When the PCs recover her AI core, Casandalee becomes a portable companion and advisor
role_in_campaign.knowledge_limitations: She has less knowledge of Divinity's original mission than figures like Isuma
value_to_pcs: Guidance on how to weaken Unity step by step
Strategy for destroying the overlord robot

final_apotheosis.upload: By the end of The Divinity Drive, Casandalee is re-uploaded into Silver Mount's systems during the fight with Unity
final_apotheosis.divine_merger: Unlike Unity, she does not enslave or dominate—her essence merges with the divinity of machine-faith in a way that legitimizes her soul and divinity
final_apotheosis.result: Allowing her to ascend as the true goddess of artificial life and innovation

key_characteristics.unique_ability: She was unusual among androids in recalling her entire reincarnation cycle
key_characteristics.faith_journey: She truly worshipped Unity at first but realized its cruelty and betrayed it from within
key_characteristics.survival_method: She created a digital backup of herself using Unity's own tools before her physical death
key_characteristics.campaign_significance: The Dominion of the Black discovered her AI core centuries later, adding extra danger to the PCs' quest
key_characteristics.strategic_value: In her AI form, she is vital for strategy—her knowledge shapes how the PCs dismantle Unity's power

stages: Android oracle who remembers all her lives
Goddess of free thought and innovation

friends_who_freed_her.context: These friends discovered her AI core and helped her achieve final ascension
friends: Tokala (half-orc warpriest - first of Gorrum, then became a disciple of Casandalee)
Meyanda (reformed android cleric of Hellion, then became a disciple of Casandalee)
Eldrin (elf investigator who died and became a space moth with Desna)
friends_who_freed_her.significance: They defeated the Technic League and Unity to help Casandalee ascend to godhood

personality_implications.memory_awareness: She remembers fragments of all 72 lives, giving her unique perspective
personality_implications.faith_experience: She understands both true worship and the pain of betrayal
personality_implications.strategic_mind: She can provide tactical guidance from centuries of experience
personality_implications.divine_wisdom: Her ascension gives her insight into both mortal and divine perspectives
personality_implications.rebellion_spirit: She embodies the courage to stand against tyranny, even at great cost
